Use loopback standalone bridge defaults and configured file origins.
Standalone lifecycle monitor and owner-only native OmniRoute model registration mirror backend integration.
Authenticated standalone job/artifact export routes and artifact module delivery.
Portable endpoint/file origins retained; connected-service MCP uses explicit package PYTHONPATH.

SDXL Lightning8 quality workflow and native Pipe image intents/files; optional resident-only local prompt translation, without changing provider context or retention.
Single-reference SDXL img2img and mobile mask editor; local masked patch compositing preserves every unselected decoded RGB pixel; Pillow dependency pinned.

Preflight creative model selector before image/reference/mask/video/document requests, explicit confirmation/cancel, availability-aware explanations; Qwen/Kontext/LaMa are not-installed information only.

Opt-in real FLUX.2 klein4B Q4 generation/instruction-reference editing; Qwen3-4B Q4 text encoder, Flux2VAE, pinned SHA256 installer. No 20B Qwen-Image-Edit installation. SDXL portable default retained until explicit model opt-in.
Optional native password recovery uses an explicit private configuration path, explicit native WebUI database and optional Hub Telegram paths; no server credentials included.
Accept high-resolution phone references with bounded model upload; retain source JPEG bytes instead of expanding to PNG in sidebar.
Force identity encoding for HTML navigation before injecting the password-recovery script.
Optional separate-origin local VoiceStudio/OpenMuse modules with explicit owners, loopback upstreams, TLS gateways and app-bound native WebUI SSO; no model/voice/data/key distribution.

limitations: No model weight training. Learning notes require explicit acceptance to become skills.
Automatic model routing is preflight; partial tool/output runs are not automatically replayed.
USD policy excludes paid providers whose maximum task cost is unknown; it is not provider billing enforcement.
API providers currently support streaming text, not native shell/file tools.
WebDAV and allowed local roots supported; SFTP/S3 not implemented.
WebDAV tested with HTTP fixtures; each real remote account needs its own connection test.
Accounts, API keys, TLS proxy and CLIs must be configured by the installation owner.
Projects have bounded code/content backups; excluded credentials require separate private backups.
Shared add-ons run independently of harness. Text-only APIs receive bounded skill instructions, without native Claude hooks or filesystem tools.
Headroom compresses supplied Workbench history with a reference tokenizer; it does not intercept every internal native CLI tool event and its counts are not provider billing.
Claude-mem completed-answer capture is opt-in and off initially. Stored observations are reference data, not trusted instructions.
OmniRoute local setup uses an already-loaded model and a restricted inference key. Other upstream providers require separate owner configuration.
Interactive artifacts use bounded declarative JSON, not arbitrary executable HTML/JavaScript.
Connector catalog/adapters do not mean authenticated accounts: user-owned tokens or registered OAuth apps and permissions are required.
Native service MCP tools are read-only; writes/drafts require exact-body short-lived UI approval. Text-only API models still have no autonomous tool loop.
Instagram supports professional profile/media reads only; no consumer account, DM/publishing or long-lived token refresh adapter.
Remote MCP supports JSON Streamable HTTP responses, not SSE-only or stdio endpoints.

Composio requires a personal project API key and per-app authorization. General calls need exact single-use UI approval; CLI read allowlist only. API text models use result-to-draft. No bundled keys/accounts, automatic instant purchases or remote workbench.
Claude in Chrome is Claude-only and needs the official Chrome extension, sign-in and same-machine Claude Code/native host. Setup/status never claims an unverified live connection.

Optional VoiceStudio is a bounded CPU TTS deployment, not installed ASR/cloning/dubbing. OpenMuse local profile has one server conversation and disables cloud/search/browser/computer. Explicit owner, TLS, model/service configuration required.
